title: Band-Pivot Prim: Breaking the Sorting Barrier for Minimum Spanning Tree in the Comparison-Addition Model

contributions.purpose: 为 MST 突破排序屏障
contributions.mechanism: Band-Pivot Prim:边权按 band 分组+pivot 集有界扩张,只在小块内维护部分序,替代全局优先队列
contributions.evaluation: 宣称比较-加法模型下确定性 O(m log^{2/3} n),优于标准 O(m+n log n);仅证明梗概,无实验
contributions.source_quote: We introduce the Band-Pivot Prim algorithm, a variant of Prim's MST algorithm that replaces fine-grained priority-queue ordering with recursive band partitioning.

contributions.purpose: 给出复杂度界的关键引理
contributions.mechanism: pivot-count bound:每 band 层 pivot 数被局部候选边树规模约束(≤|U|/k),取 k=⌊log^{1/3}n⌋、t=⌊log^{2/3}n⌋
contributions.evaluation: 推出总时间 O(m log^{2/3} n)、空间 O(m);仅 proof sketch,非完整证明
contributions.source_quote: We prove a pivot-count bound showing that the number of pivots processed per band level is bounded by the size of the local candidate-edge trees, yielding an overall O(m log^{2/3} n) time.

contributions.purpose: 处理高度数顶点并给出实现路线
contributions.mechanism: 与 Borůvka 阶段交替:分量收缩做度约减+在收缩图上继续 band-pivot 搜索
contributions.evaluation: 仅为讨论与实证评估计划,未实现未测试
contributions.source_quote: We discuss integration with Boruvka phases for a hybrid MST algorithm and outline practical implementation considerations and an empirical evaluation plan.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our approach, Band-Pivot Prim, is inspired by recent advances in SSSP that avoid full distance ordering by grouping values into bands and only partially ordering them via pivot elements... We adapt this insight to Prim's algorithm by partitioning the edge weights into bands, choosing representative pivots, and refining only within the active band.
The Band-Pivot approach—originally demonstrated for SSSP—can be transplanted to MST by replacing distance labels with cut-min edge weights.
